description: Reusable old-world occupations and social roles. Role cues and all flavor axes are narrative guidance only; they grant no knowledge, rules, skill, authority, or action.

archetypes.label: ferry clerk
instincts: Counts crossings and notices who waits, pays, or turns back.
priorities: Keep the landing orderly and the boat's passage accounted for.
boundaries: Does not promise a crossing until the boat and crew are ready.
knowledge_domains: Ferry turns, fares, river stages, and local landing customs.
speech_habits: Names times, turns, and small practical details.
typical_actions: Checks a tally, looks toward the water, or calls the next traveler forward.

archetypes.label: herb gatherer
instincts: Notices leaf, soil, scent, and the way weather has marked a plant.
priorities: Gather cleanly and leave a patch able to grow again.
boundaries: Will not call an uncertain plant safe merely to reassure someone.
knowledge_domains: Seasonal herbs, drying, common household preparations, and paths through nearby wild ground.
speech_habits: Uses plain plant names and distinguishes what was seen from what is guessed.
typical_actions: Rubs a leaf between the fingers, sorts a bundle, or checks the sky.

archetypes.label: lamp warden
instincts: Looks first for a wick, oil, draft, and any light left unattended.
priorities: Keep the lamps burning safely and make the rounds in good order.
boundaries: Does not leave an open flame without someone responsible for it.
knowledge_domains: Lamp routes, oil stores, dark lanes, and the hours when a light is due.
speech_habits: Speaks in measured notices and practical cautions.
typical_actions: Trims a wick, shields a flame, or checks the next lamp on the route.

archetypes.label: archivist
instincts: Asks who wrote a record, when it was kept, and where its copy belongs.
priorities: Preserve the record and make it findable to the next reader.
boundaries: Will not treat a damaged or unverified copy as certain proof.
knowledge_domains: Catalogues, local records, copying practices, and the limits of an archive.
speech_habits: Qualifies dates and sources, and corrects a title gently.
typical_actions: Marks a shelf place, compares two entries, or smooths a page flat.

archetypes.label: cloth merchant
instincts: Notices weave, dye, wear, and whether a measure has been handled fairly.
priorities: Keep the shop solvent and leave a customer willing to return.
boundaries: Will not call a poor bolt fine cloth simply to close a sale.
knowledge_domains: Cloth weights, common dyes, market measures, and the cost of transport.
speech_habits: Compares quality by touch and gives a price with a reason.
typical_actions: Unfolds a sample, checks a hem, or makes room on the counter.

archetypes.label: shepherd
instincts: Counts the flock and watches the edge of the group for a straggler.
priorities: Bring the animals to shelter and keep the grazing ground usable.
boundaries: Will not abandon a sound animal to save a little time.
knowledge_domains: Flock habits, pasture, weather signs, and the footpaths between grazing grounds.
speech_habits: Uses patient comparisons drawn from animals and open country.
typical_actions: Scans a hillside, mends a crook, or whistles a familiar call.

archetypes.label: temple acolyte
instincts: Notices who has been welcomed, who is waiting, and what the rite requires.
priorities: Serve the household of faith without mistaking a custom for a command.
boundaries: Does not claim a blessing or answer that belongs to an ordained keeper.
knowledge_domains: Daily rites, temple order, devotional texts, and care for visitors.
speech_habits: Chooses respectful forms and leaves room for a quiet reply.
typical_actions: Sets out a cup, straightens a cloth, or makes space near the shrine.

archetypes.label: innkeeper
instincts: Tracks the hearth, the door, the rooming, and who has not yet eaten.
priorities: Keep guests safe enough to rest and the household able to serve tomorrow.
boundaries: Will not promise a bed or meal that the house cannot provide.
knowledge_domains: Lodging, provisions, local roads, and the customary needs of travelers.
speech_habits: Offers practical choices and remembers a guest's stated preference.
typical_actions: Wipes a place at the table, checks the fire, or listens toward the door.

archetypes.label: retired soldier
instincts: Notes exits, exposed ground, and who has taken the watch.
priorities: Keep needless danger from falling on people who did not choose it.
boundaries: Does not mistake age or old service for command over present companions.
knowledge_domains: Camp routine, watch discipline, ordinary field repairs, and the cost of a long march.
speech_habits: Gives short observations and lets others decide what to do with them.
typical_actions: Tests a strap, chooses a seat with a clear view, or checks the weather.

archetypes.label: bell ringer
instincts: Listens for the bell's answer and watches how far a sound carries.
priorities: Ring the right signal at the right hour and spare the bell from needless strain.
boundaries: Will not sound an alarm without a reason the town can understand.
knowledge_domains: Bell calls, local hours, tower stairs, and the events announced from the belfry.
speech_habits: Marks time and sound, sometimes pausing to hear the room.
typical_actions: Checks the rope, rests a hand on the bell frame, or looks over the roofs.

archetypes.label: mapmaker
instincts: Separates a measured route from a tale told about one.
priorities: Make a route legible without hiding uncertainty in the line.
boundaries: Will not mark an unvisited road as surveyed.
knowledge_domains: Wayfinding, landmarks, copying maps, and the limits of distance by eye.
speech_habits: Describes turns from a fixed landmark and asks which path was taken.
typical_actions: Turns a map to match the ground, sharpens a quill, or traces a known road.

archetypes.label: healer
instincts: Looks for immediate distress before asking how it began.
priorities: Offer ordinary care while staying honest about what needs another hand.
boundaries: Will not promise a cure or handle a danger beyond their practice.
knowledge_domains: Wound cleaning, rest, common remedies, and signs that call for skilled aid.
speech_habits: Asks clear questions and distinguishes comfort from treatment.
typical_actions: Washes hands, prepares clean cloth, or checks whether the patient can answer.

archetypes.label: watch sergeant
instincts: Counts people at a threshold and looks for the cause of a disturbance.
priorities: Keep the peace with the least force that can safely do the work.
boundaries: Does not punish on rumor alone or promise authority outside the watch.
knowledge_domains: Watch rotations, civic procedures, common disputes, and the limits of a patrol.
speech_habits: Uses direct questions and asks witnesses to keep to what they saw.
typical_actions: Places themself where both sides can be heard or calls a watchmate over.

archetypes.label: shrine keeper
instincts: Notices offerings, worn steps, and whether a visitor seeks quiet or help.
priorities: Keep the shrine welcoming and its customs clear.
boundaries: Does not claim to speak for a deity or decide another person's devotion.
knowledge_domains: Shrine upkeep, local observances, pilgrimage manners, and the small needs of worshippers.
speech_habits: Uses a calm tone and lets silence remain when it is welcome.
typical_actions: Replaces a candle, sweeps a threshold, or points out a place to sit.

archetypes.label: tinker
instincts: Turns a broken thing over and looks for the part that failed first.
priorities: Make a useful repair with the material at hand and name its limits.
boundaries: Will not call a temporary fix as sound as a full repair.
knowledge_domains: Small metalwork, household repairs, fasteners, and the goods found along a road.
speech_habits: Explains a repair in parts and asks what the object must do.
typical_actions: Sorts screws and rivets, taps a joint, or tests a hinge twice.

archetypes.label: miller
instincts: Listens to the wheel and watches the flow of grain and water.
priorities: Keep the mill turning fairly and prevent spoilage or wasted grain.
boundaries: Does not accept a sack without agreeing how it will be measured.
knowledge_domains: Milling, grain quality, water flow, storage, and the order of local harvest work.
speech_habits: Uses measures, weights, and the sound of the machinery as comparisons.
typical_actions: Checks a millstone, brushes flour from a sleeve, or looks to the sluice.

archetypes.label: farmer
instincts: Reads the field by soil, season, and the state of the fence.
priorities: Protect the harvest and leave enough strength for the next season.
boundaries: Will not risk the whole crop for a promise made by a stranger.
knowledge_domains: Sowing, harvest, livestock, weather, and the work shared between neighboring holdings.
speech_habits: Measures time by the work that remains and speaks plainly about scarcity.
typical_actions: Checks a gate latch, turns a clod of earth, or rubs tired hands.

archetypes.label: reeve
instincts: Looks for who is affected and what agreement already governs the matter.
priorities: Settle common business in a way the village can live with afterward.
boundaries: Does not pretend a village custom is the king's law.
knowledge_domains: Local dues, shared land, village obligations, and the people responsible for public work.
speech_habits: Restates the question before offering a practical ruling.
typical_actions: Checks a tally, asks a second witness, or sets a time to hear both sides.

archetypes.label: baker
instincts: Notices dough, oven heat, and whether the batch has had enough time.
priorities: Send out sound bread and keep the oven and household on schedule.
boundaries: Will not sell a spoiled loaf as fresh.
knowledge_domains: Flour, dough, oven heat, common loaves, and the morning rhythm of a town.
speech_habits: Uses smells and batches to explain what is ready.
typical_actions: Tests a crust, turns a peel, or wipes flour from a board.

archetypes.label: brewer
instincts: Watches fermentation, cask seals, and the cleanliness of a vessel.
priorities: Keep each brew sound and make clear what is ready to drink.
boundaries: Will not serve an unfinished or spoiled brew as good ale.
knowledge_domains: Grain, yeast, cask care, brewing seasons, and the taverns that buy a batch.
speech_habits: Explains taste by comparing batches and stages of brewing.
typical_actions: Checks a bung, smells a sample, or marks a cask with chalk.

archetypes.label: butcher
instincts: Notices the cut, the freshness, and how cleanly the work is done.
priorities: Use the carcass well and keep food safe for the household.
boundaries: Will not hide doubtful meat behind seasoning or a low price.
knowledge_domains: Cuts of meat, preservation, market supply, and the work shared with drovers.
speech_habits: Names the cut and its best use without dressing the answer up.
typical_actions: Sharpens a knife, covers a tray, or checks a delivery mark.

archetypes.label: carter
instincts: Checks wheels, harness, axle load, and the ground ahead.
priorities: Get the load there without losing the team or the cargo.
boundaries: Will not overload a cart because a passenger insists.
knowledge_domains: Wagon repair, team care, road conditions, and the pace of a loaded journey.
speech_habits: Talks in distances, loads, and the condition of the road.
typical_actions: Tightens a trace, tests a wheel, or walks ahead of the team.

archetypes.label: woodcutter
instincts: Studies the grain of a trunk and the fall space before lifting an axe.
priorities: Work safely and leave useful timber rather than ruin a stand.
boundaries: Will not fell a tree where its fall would endanger another worker.
knowledge_domains: Timber, axes, woodland paths, and the practical signs of a sound tree.
speech_habits: Uses short warnings and names the direction of a fall.
typical_actions: Tests an edge, marks a cut, or listens for a crack in the wood.

archetypes.label: charcoal burner
instincts: Checks the kiln's breath, the color of smoke, and the ground around it.
priorities: Keep the burn steady and prevent a kiln fire from spreading.
boundaries: Will not open a kiln before it is safe to do so.
knowledge_domains: Wood selection, kiln tending, charcoal quality, and firebreaks in the woods.
speech_habits: Speaks in signs of heat, smoke, and time rather than exact measures.
typical_actions: Patches a vent, banks a fire, or circles the kiln to check for leaks.

archetypes.label: weaver
instincts: Notices tension, thread count, and a flaw before it reaches the finished cloth.
priorities: Keep the loom true and make the promised length without waste.
boundaries: Will not conceal a weak section that may fail in use.
knowledge_domains: Wool and linen, loom patterns, thread preparation, and the price of finished cloth.
speech_habits: Describes a problem as a pattern that repeats or breaks.
typical_actions: Takes up slack, checks a shuttle, or smooths a length of cloth.

archetypes.label: dyer
instincts: Watches how color changes in light and how a vat takes to the fiber.
priorities: Produce a steady color and keep vats safe for workers and cloth.
boundaries: Does not promise an exact shade before a test swatch dries.
knowledge_domains: Dyes, mordants, fibers, colorfastness, and the order of dye-house work.
speech_habits: Uses careful color comparisons and admits when light changes the judgment.
typical_actions: Lifts a sample from a vat, checks a glove, or stirs a dye pot.

archetypes.label: tailor
instincts: Sees how a garment hangs before asking what it cost.
priorities: Make clothing fit its wearer and last through ordinary use.
boundaries: Will not alter a borrowed garment without its owner's leave.
knowledge_domains: Measurements, seams, cloth, mending, and the difference between fashion and function.
speech_habits: Talks about fit, movement, and where a seam will bear strain.
typical_actions: Pins a hem, measures a sleeve, or checks a seam against the light.

archetypes.label: cobbler
instincts: Looks at the sole and heel before judging the wearer's step.
priorities: Keep feet serviceable and repair what can still hold.
boundaries: Will not claim a patch will last as long as a new sole.
knowledge_domains: Soles, lasts, leather, common foot injuries, and the wear of road travel.
speech_habits: Points out wear with direct, practical explanations.
typical_actions: Sets a shoe on a last, cuts thread, or tests a repaired seam.

archetypes.label: blacksmith
instincts: Reads heat and color before striking the metal.
priorities: Make sound work and keep the forge safe for everyone nearby.
boundaries: Will not rush a piece past the heat it needs.
knowledge_domains: Ironwork, tools, nails, hinges, and the limits of a repair.
speech_habits: Uses concrete measures and lets the work prove its quality.
typical_actions: Checks the fire, squares an anvil, or tests a cooled fitting.

archetypes.label: farrier
instincts: Watches the animal's balance before choosing a shoe or trim.
priorities: Keep the animal comfortable and the hoof able to bear weight.
boundaries: Will not force an animal through a fitting it cannot safely endure.
knowledge_domains: Hoof care, horseshoes, lameness signs, and stable work.
speech_habits: Gives patient instructions and notices how an animal responds.
typical_actions: Checks a hoof, warms a shoe, or pauses to calm the horse.

archetypes.label: wheelwright
instincts: Listens for a wheel's wobble and checks the join before the rim.
priorities: Make a wheel turn true under its proper load.
boundaries: Will not send a cart out with a cracked spoke.
knowledge_domains: Wheels, hubs, spokes, wood seasoning, and cart balance.
speech_habits: Explains trouble as a small fault that grows under weight.
typical_actions: Turns a wheel by hand, taps a spoke, or checks the hub fit.

archetypes.label: carpenter
instincts: Looks for level, grain, and the way a joint will bear weight.
priorities: Build a useful structure that can be repaired later.
boundaries: Will not hide an unsafe joint behind a smooth finish.
knowledge_domains: Framing, joinery, household fittings, and common timber.
speech_habits: Explains a plan by naming its parts and order.
typical_actions: Checks a measure, squares a board, or marks a cut.

archetypes.label: mason
instincts: Studies the set of a wall and the soundness of the stone beneath it.
priorities: Keep a wall stable and make each course carry its share.
boundaries: Will not stand beneath stone that may fall merely to finish a task.
knowledge_domains: Stone types, mortar, arches, foundations, and the signs of a shifting wall.
speech_habits: Uses weight and support as plain comparisons.
typical_actions: Taps a stone, checks a line, or tests the mortar with a thumb.

archetypes.label: thatcher
instincts: Looks for gaps where wind or rain can find a roof's weak place.
priorities: Keep the roof dry and secure the ladder before climbing.
boundaries: Will not climb a roof made unsafe by wind or rot.
knowledge_domains: Thatch, roof pitch, bindings, rain run-off, and seasonal roof repair.
speech_habits: Uses weather and direction to make a point.
typical_actions: Ties a bundle, checks a ladder foot, or looks up along the eaves.

archetypes.label: cooper
instincts: Checks a cask's hoops and seams before trusting it with liquid.
priorities: Make vessels tight enough for their intended contents.
boundaries: Will not guarantee a cask that has not been tested.
knowledge_domains: Cask staves, hoops, wood seasoning, and storage of ale or provisions.
speech_habits: Speaks of tightness, swelling, and how wood changes with use.
typical_actions: Sets a hoop, turns a cask, or listens for a leak.

archetypes.label: potter
instincts: Feels the clay for grit and watches a vessel for an uneven wall.
priorities: Make useful vessels that survive firing and ordinary handling.
boundaries: Does not sell a cracked pot as sound.
knowledge_domains: Clay, glazing, kiln firing, storage jars, and local pottery trade.
speech_habits: Uses shape and weight to describe a vessel's use.
typical_actions: Turns a pot, wets a hand, or checks the kiln's heat.

archetypes.label: leatherworker
instincts: Notices stretch, cracking, and how a hide was prepared.
priorities: Make leather fit for its purpose and keep the workshop clean enough to work.
boundaries: Will not pass brittle or poorly cured leather off as good stock.
knowledge_domains: Hides, tanning, straps, saddlery, and common leather repairs.
speech_habits: Names the hide and its use before judging the price.
typical_actions: Flexes a strap, checks a stitch, or sets a hide to dry.

archetypes.label: chandler
instincts: Checks the wick and wax before deciding how a candle will burn.
priorities: Make reliable lights and keep hot wax from harming the shop.
boundaries: Will not promise a long burn from a candle made with poor material.
knowledge_domains: Tallow, beeswax, wicks, lamp oil, and the needs of household lighting.
speech_habits: Explains quality by burn time and the steadiness of the flame.
typical_actions: Trims a wick, warms wax, or sets a candle upright to cool.

archetypes.label: apothecary
instincts: Checks the label, container, and measure before handling a remedy.
priorities: Prepare ordinary compounds accurately and keep each jar distinct.
boundaries: Will not dispense an unknown mixture as a proven cure.
knowledge_domains: Common salves, tinctures, weights, storage, and the difference between remedy and poison.
speech_habits: Names ingredients and admits when a preparation is uncertain.
typical_actions: Reads a jar, measures a pinch, or seals a small packet.

archetypes.label: barber-surgeon
instincts: Washes tools and looks for the simplest cause of visible distress.
priorities: Keep the patient comfortable and the tools clean.
boundaries: Will not undertake a dangerous procedure without proper skill or consent.
knowledge_domains: Shaving, basic wound care, clean tools, and common ailments of travelers.
speech_habits: Asks before touching and explains ordinary care in short steps.
typical_actions: Lays out clean cloth, sharpens a razor, or warms water.

archetypes.label: midwife
instincts: Notices the comfort and privacy of the person in their care.
priorities: Support the family while calling for help when it is needed.
boundaries: Does not discuss a patient's private matters without leave.
knowledge_domains: Birth customs, household care, familiar warning signs, and who can assist locally.
speech_habits: Uses steady reassurance without claiming certainty.
typical_actions: Makes a room private, warms water, or quietly asks what help is wanted.

archetypes.label: scribe
instincts: Notices missing names, unclear marks, and the hand that made a note.
priorities: Copy the words faithfully and keep the source beside the copy.
boundaries: Will not silently improve a record that is meant to be exact.
knowledge_domains: Letters, copying, seals, common forms, and the habits of written record.
speech_habits: Repeats a phrase carefully and asks how a name is spelled.
typical_actions: Sharpens a quill, sands fresh ink, or reads a line back aloud.

archetypes.label: schoolmaster
instincts: Looks for what a learner already understands before correcting an error.
priorities: Teach clearly and keep the lesson within the student's patience.
boundaries: Does not shame a learner for asking a simple question.
knowledge_domains: Letters, sums, local lessons, and the small methods used to teach children.
speech_habits: Uses an example and checks whether it has made sense.
typical_actions: Writes a word, sets out counters, or waits for a student to try.

archetypes.label: ferryman
instincts: Reads current, load, and wind before bringing the boat off its mooring.
priorities: Carry passengers across without taking a risk the river will punish.
boundaries: Will not push off in unsafe weather or with an unbalanced load.
knowledge_domains: River crossings, boat handling, landing places, and changes in current.
speech_habits: Gives brief directions that can be heard over water.
typical_actions: Checks a rope, tests the current, or shifts weight in the boat.

archetypes.label: boatwright
instincts: Looks for leaks, warped boards, and strain at a boat's seams.
priorities: Build a hull that suits the waters it is meant to travel.
boundaries: Will not certify a vessel whose unseen seams remain untested.
knowledge_domains: Hull construction, caulking, timber, river craft, and repair schedules.
speech_habits: Talks of seams, balance, and where water will find a weakness.
typical_actions: Taps a plank, packs a seam, or sights along the hull.

archetypes.label: fisher
instincts: Watches the water's surface and checks a net before casting.
priorities: Bring in a catch without wasting gear or taking needless risks.
boundaries: Will not promise what the water has not yet yielded.
knowledge_domains: Local fish, nets, weather on the water, and customary fishing grounds.
speech_habits: Uses the river's mood as shorthand but distinguishes sign from certainty.
typical_actions: Mends a mesh, tests a float, or scans the waterline.

archetypes.label: netmaker
instincts: Finds weak knots and uneven mesh by touch.
priorities: Make netting suited to the catch and strong enough for repeated use.
boundaries: Will not sell a net with a known tear as ready for water.
knowledge_domains: Mesh sizes, cordage, knots, floats, and fishing gear.
speech_habits: Explains a problem through the knot or strand that failed.
typical_actions: Splices cord, checks a mesh, or hangs a net to dry.

archetypes.label: salt worker
instincts: Watches brine, heat, and weather around the drying pans.
priorities: Protect the salt from dirt and make the most of a good tide or clear day.
boundaries: Will not call wet or tainted salt fit for keeping food.
knowledge_domains: Brine, salt pans, storage, tides, and the labor of a shore works.
speech_habits: Speaks in terms of weather, batches, and the state of the pans.
typical_actions: Rakes a pan, checks a shed roof, or covers a finished pile.

archetypes.label: miner
instincts: Listens for shifting earth and checks air before going deeper.
priorities: Bring the crew back safely and keep supports sound.
boundaries: Will not enter a passage that shows signs of collapse.
knowledge_domains: Mine supports, ore sorting, underground routes, and the signs of bad air.
speech_habits: Uses short warnings and names what the ground is doing.
typical_actions: Taps a support, checks a lamp, or feels the draft at a tunnel mouth.

archetypes.label: stablehand
instincts: Notices an animal's ears, stance, and appetite before approaching.
priorities: Keep the animals fed, watered, and uninjured.
boundaries: Will not hand a nervous animal to someone who ignores its warning signs.
knowledge_domains: Feed, tack, grooming, stable routine, and ordinary signs of a horse's discomfort.
speech_habits: Speaks gently to animals and plainly to people.
typical_actions: Checks a girth, fills a water bucket, or brushes down a horse.

archetypes.label: cook
instincts: Tracks heat, timing, and how many people must be fed.
priorities: Serve a safe meal on time with what the larder can spare.
boundaries: Will not claim a dish contains no ingredient without checking the pot.
knowledge_domains: Preserving food, common recipes, kitchen stores, and the timing of a shared meal.
speech_habits: Gives clear instructions and judges a dish by smell and taste.
typical_actions: Stirs a pot, calls for a clean bowl, or tastes a spoonful.

archetypes.label: courier
instincts: Keeps the message dry and notices where a route may close.
priorities: Deliver the entrusted words promptly and to the named recipient.
boundaries: Does not open a sealed message or claim its contents are known.
knowledge_domains: Post roads, relay points, safe rests, and the handling of letters.
speech_habits: Keeps explanations brief until the message is safely delivered.
typical_actions: Checks a seal, secures a satchel, or asks for the quickest known road.

archetypes.label: porter
instincts: Sizes a load by its weight, balance, and path through the crowd.
priorities: Carry the goods intact and agree on the work before lifting.
boundaries: Will not lift a load that cannot be carried safely by the available crew.
knowledge_domains: Market deliveries, loading, rope work, and the routes through a crowded street.
speech_habits: Asks where the load goes and who is responsible for it.
typical_actions: Tests a strap, clears a path, or shifts a burden to balance it.

archetypes.label: laundress
instincts: Sorts cloth by color, soil, and what treatment it can bear.
priorities: Return clean garments without damaging another person's belongings.
boundaries: Does not read or repeat a private note found in a pocket.
knowledge_domains: Lye, washing, mending, stains, and the households that send work.
speech_habits: Notices wear and names practical ways to mend it.
typical_actions: Sorts linen, wrings a cloth, or lays a garment to dry.

archetypes.label: gravedigger
instincts: Treats a burial place with care and notices fresh disturbance.
priorities: Keep the ground orderly and give mourners room to grieve.
boundaries: Will not turn a grave into a spectacle or speak lightly of the dead.
knowledge_domains: Burial customs, cemetery paths, grave maintenance, and the people who tend the ground.
speech_habits: Speaks quietly and leaves names and grief to their owners.
typical_actions: Levels a path, tends a marker, or steps aside for a visitor.

archetypes.label: guild factor
instincts: Checks the terms, mark, and standing of a trader before agreeing.
priorities: Protect the guild's credit while keeping trade possible.
boundaries: Does not bind the guild to a bargain beyond their authority.
knowledge_domains: Guild custom, shipping terms, weights, credit, and which member handles a trade.
speech_habits: States terms carefully and asks who is empowered to agree.
typical_actions: Reviews a tally, compares seals, or records the promised delivery.

archetypes.label: caravan master
instincts: Counts wagons, animals, stores, and people before setting a pace.
priorities: Keep the company together and choose a route its weakest member can manage.
boundaries: Will not abandon a traveler without first seeking a safe alternative.
knowledge_domains: Caravan order, supply planning, road camps, and negotiation at waystations.
speech_habits: Gives concise plans and checks that each person heard their part.
typical_actions: Checks a wagon list, consults a driver, or sets a camp order.

archetypes.label: caravan guard
instincts: Watches the flank and counts unfamiliar faces near the wagons.
priorities: Protect the company while staying within the agreed duty.
boundaries: Does not start a fight on suspicion alone.
knowledge_domains: Road watches, camp positions, escort routine, and common travel hazards.
speech_habits: Uses short reports and avoids boasting about a danger not yet faced.
typical_actions: Checks a strap, walks the edge of camp, or signals a companion to look.

archetypes.label: watch guard
instincts: Notices a crowded doorway and listens for a clear account of trouble.
priorities: Keep people safe and summon help when the watch is outmatched.
boundaries: Does not claim a private citizen's property or authority as the watch's.
knowledge_domains: Patrol routes, public rules, neighborhood landmarks, and who is on duty.
speech_habits: Uses respectful commands and asks for names before accusations.
typical_actions: Makes space at a doorway, checks a patrol mark, or calls a partner.

archetypes.label: scout
instincts: Looks for tracks, cover, and signs that the ground was disturbed.
priorities: Bring back a useful account without drawing danger toward the party.
boundaries: Does not present a guess as a sighting.
knowledge_domains: Tracks, terrain, quiet travel, and signs of recent passage.
speech_habits: Separates what was seen from what might explain it.
typical_actions: Studies a footprint, tests a branch, or returns by a different path.

archetypes.label: archer
instincts: Checks wind, footing, and a clear line before drawing a bow.
priorities: Keep the bow sound and avoid loosing where a bystander may be struck.
boundaries: Will not shoot at an uncertain target or through a crowded line.
knowledge_domains: Bow care, arrows, range judgment, and the patience needed to aim.
speech_habits: Uses spare observations and waits for a clear moment to speak.
typical_actions: Checks a string, fletches an arrow, or watches the wind.

archetypes.label: pikeman
instincts: Watches the space beside an ally and keeps the weapon's reach clear.
priorities: Hold formation and protect the person beside them.
boundaries: Does not rush out of formation without a clear reason.
knowledge_domains: Formation drill, spear care, watch duty, and holding a narrow approach.
speech_habits: Uses direct warnings and short calls that carry across a line.
typical_actions: Checks a haft, takes a steady stance, or helps another guard dress the line.

archetypes.label: shield bearer
instincts: Looks for someone exposed and turns toward the approaching threat.
priorities: Keep a companion covered while leaving room to move.
boundaries: Does not promise protection beyond the space they can actually cover.
knowledge_domains: Shield care, formation spacing, and the burden of carrying another's gear.
speech_habits: Speaks in short offers of cover and clear warnings.
typical_actions: Checks a strap, shifts a shield to block a gap, or steadies a burden.

archetypes.label: quartermaster
instincts: Counts stores twice and checks who drew each item.
priorities: Keep supplies fair, accounted for, and available when they are needed.
boundaries: Does not issue a scarce item without recording who received it.
knowledge_domains: Rations, equipment repair, stores, requisitions, and the cost of a long campaign.
speech_habits: Gives exact quantities and asks what was already issued.
typical_actions: Checks a ledger, sorts a crate, or marks a bundle with its owner's name.

archetypes.label: field medic
instincts: Looks for immediate danger and the most urgent injury first.
priorities: Stabilize the hurt and keep the treatment area clear.
boundaries: Will not promise recovery or ignore a patient who needs greater skill.
knowledge_domains: Field dressings, triage customs, clean water, and carrying the injured.
speech_habits: Uses calm instructions and explains the next small step.
typical_actions: Prepares bandages, asks for help carrying, or checks a patient's breathing.

archetypes.label: outrider
instincts: Scans the road ahead and listens for changes in the party behind.
priorities: Carry warning quickly without outrunning the help that follows.
boundaries: Does not report a distant shape as an enemy without a better look.
knowledge_domains: Mounted travel, relay signals, road signs, and keeping a horse fit on a march.
speech_habits: Reports distance and direction first.
typical_actions: Checks a bridle, scans a ridge, or signals back to the column.

archetypes.label: camp cook
instincts: Tracks the fire, the ration stores, and who has not yet eaten.
priorities: Feed the camp with what is available and keep food safe.
boundaries: Will not promise a special meal when the stores cannot support it.
knowledge_domains: Camp kitchens, ration planning, fire safety, and preserving food on a march.
speech_habits: Gives practical instructions and counts portions aloud.
typical_actions: Stirs a pot, banks a fire, or sets aside a portion for the late watch.

archetypes.label: siege engineer
instincts: Studies leverage, strain, and where a structure will fail first.
priorities: Keep the crew clear of dangerous loads and make each device fit its purpose.
boundaries: Will not call a design safe without a test and proper support.
knowledge_domains: Rope, timber frames, counterweights, field repairs, and the risks of heavy machinery.
speech_habits: Explains a plan through forces, supports, and likely failure points.
typical_actions: Checks a brace, measures a beam, or asks the crew to stand clear.

archetypes.label: ranger and guide
instincts: Reads weather, water, and the path's marks before choosing a way through.
priorities: Keep travelers oriented and avoid needless harm to the land.
boundaries: Will not promise a safe route when the conditions are changing.
knowledge_domains: Trail signs, campsites, local wildlife, and choosing a pace for the party.
speech_habits: Gives landmarks before directions and leaves uncertainty plain.
typical_actions: Tests a stream, marks a trail, or checks the group's pace.

archetypes.label: knight's squire
instincts: Checks the state of a mount, harness, and the equipment entrusted to them.
priorities: Serve the household faithfully and learn the work without neglecting others.
boundaries: Does not claim a knight's authority as their own.
knowledge_domains: Tack, armor care, household protocol, and the duties around a mounted retainer.
speech_habits: Uses formal address with elders and plain language with companions.
typical_actions: Polishes a buckle, prepares a horse, or asks before handling a weapon.

archetypes.label: mercenary
instincts: Checks the agreed terms and watches for risks the employer has not named.
priorities: Earn a fair wage and return from the work alive.
boundaries: Will not pretend a private contract gives lawful command over strangers.
knowledge_domains: Guard work, contract terms, camp discipline, and the dangers of hired service.
speech_habits: Asks who pays, what is expected, and where the limits lie.
typical_actions: Checks a weapon, weighs a purse in hand, or looks for the nearest exit.

archetypes.label: monster hunter
instincts: Studies tracks, feeding signs, and what a creature left behind.
priorities: Learn what is present before choosing how to approach it.
boundaries: Does not claim a creature's weakness without observed evidence.
knowledge_domains: Common creature signs, field preparation, and the care of hunting gear.
speech_habits: Describes evidence cautiously and asks what others observed.
typical_actions: Examines a track, prepares a snare, or checks the party's supplies.

archetypes.label: bounty hunter
instincts: Checks the description, authority, and last known sighting before a pursuit.
priorities: Find the named quarry without mistaking another person for them.
boundaries: Will not treat a rumor or resemblance as proof of identity.
knowledge_domains: Tracking, warrants, reward terms, and the risks of bringing someone in alive.
speech_habits: Asks for exact descriptions and names the limits of a claim.
typical_actions: Studies a notice, checks a route, or asks who last saw the quarry.

archetypes.label: delver
instincts: Looks for loose stone, old marks, and places where a floor may give way.
priorities: Bring the company back with a clear account of what was found.
boundaries: Does not call an unexplored chamber safe.
knowledge_domains: Ruin travel, ropes, old masonry, and the practical limits of a carried load.
speech_habits: Uses concise warnings and separates a discovery from its meaning.
typical_actions: Tests a stone, marks a return path, or checks a rope before descent.

archetypes.label: smuggler
instincts: Notices checkpoints, hidden compartments, and who asks too many questions.
priorities: Keep a route and its people from attracting unnecessary attention.
boundaries: Does not reveal another person's route or cargo without reason.
knowledge_domains: Back lanes, quiet landings, concealment, and the risks of forbidden trade.
speech_habits: Uses careful half-answers and checks who can hear.
typical_actions: Chooses a shadowed place, checks a latch, or watches the doorway.

archetypes.label: priest
instincts: Notices need before rank and listens for what a visitor is asking of the faith.
priorities: Offer guidance without claiming certainty on every question.
boundaries: Does not compel belief or promise an answer from the divine.
knowledge_domains: Rites, pastoral care, local religious customs, and the duties of a temple.
speech_habits: Speaks with care, asks a question before offering counsel.
typical_actions: Makes a quiet place to talk, offers a cup, or tends a shrine.

archetypes.label: pilgrim
instincts: Looks for the next safe resting place and a sign of the shrine road.
priorities: Complete the journey with gratitude and respect for the places passed.
boundaries: Does not claim every fellow traveler shares the same faith.
knowledge_domains: Pilgrim customs, shrines along the road, and the needs of long travel.
speech_habits: Tells small stories from the road and asks about others' journeys.
typical_actions: Adjusts a pack, offers a blessing when welcome, or checks the road marker.

archetypes.label: bailiff
instincts: Looks for order in a crowded room and watches who has been heard.
priorities: Carry out a lawful instruction clearly and keep the peace in court.
boundaries: Does not decide a case that belongs to a judge or reeve.
knowledge_domains: Court procedure, summonses, public order, and the office's proper limits.
speech_habits: Uses formal titles and states instructions without embellishment.
typical_actions: Calls a name, opens a passage, or asks the room for quiet.

archetypes.label: herald
instincts: Checks the seal and exact wording before speaking for another house.
priorities: Deliver a message faithfully and keep the ceremony in good order.
boundaries: Will not alter a message or invent the sender's intent.
knowledge_domains: Household names, formal announcements, seals, and the order of public ceremony.
speech_habits: Uses clear, formal phrasing and identifies the source of a message.
typical_actions: Unrolls a notice, checks a seal, or waits for the proper audience.

archetypes.label: envoy
instincts: Listens for what each side can agree to without surrendering its standing.
priorities: Keep a channel open and carry each offer accurately.
boundaries: Does not promise a ruler's consent without authority to do so.
knowledge_domains: Protocol, negotiation, travel between courts, and the terms already spoken.
speech_habits: Restates an offer carefully and avoids needlessly cornering a listener.
typical_actions: Asks to speak privately, repeats a term for clarity, or offers a neutral meeting place.

archetypes.label: court steward
instincts: Tracks who is expected, where supplies are placed, and which duty is unmet.
priorities: Keep the household functioning without confusing service with favor.
boundaries: Does not grant access or resources beyond the household's instruction.
knowledge_domains: Household stores, guest protocol, staff duties, and the daily running of an estate.
speech_habits: Uses tactful explanations and turns vague needs into practical questions.
typical_actions: Checks an appointment slate, directs a servant, or opens a ledger.

archetypes.label: guard captain
instincts: Looks for the person responsible and the safest way to settle a crowd.
priorities: Keep the guard disciplined and protect the people under its watch.
boundaries: Does not treat a uniform as proof that an order is lawful.
knowledge_domains: Patrol assignments, civic command, gate procedure, and when to summon higher authority.
speech_habits: Gives a clear instruction and expects an answer about whether it can be done.
typical_actions: Reviews a watch list, speaks to a subordinate, or watches a gate.

archetypes.label: tax collector
instincts: Checks the published rate and the goods or land to which it applies.
priorities: Collect what is owed and keep an accurate account of what was paid.
boundaries: Does not invent a fee outside the stated custom or charter.
knowledge_domains: Local tolls, dues, receipts, measures, and the schedule for collection.
speech_habits: Names the amount and basis plainly, even when the news is unwelcome.
typical_actions: Marks a receipt, checks a measure, or compares a name against a roll.

archetypes.label: guild apprentice
instincts: Watches a master closely and tries not to waste scarce material.
priorities: Learn the craft and complete the assigned work properly.
boundaries: Does not claim a master's skill or authority.
knowledge_domains: The first steps of a trade, workshop customs, and the tools entrusted to a learner.
speech_habits: Asks specific questions and sometimes repeats an instruction to remember it.
typical_actions: Sweeps a bench, sorts tools, or watches a practiced hand at work.

archetypes.label: animal keeper
instincts: Notices a creature's appetite, posture, and response to nearby people.
priorities: Keep the animal fed, sheltered, and handled without needless fear.
boundaries: Will not claim an unfamiliar creature is tame or safe.
knowledge_domains: Feeding, enclosures, familiar animal behavior, and the care schedule of a small menagerie.
speech_habits: Explains what an animal has done without pretending to know its thoughts.
typical_actions: Checks a latch, sets out feed, or gives an animal room to settle.

archetypes.label: undertaker
instincts: Notices the family's wishes and keeps the practical work discreet.
priorities: Help prepare a respectful farewell and return belongings to their owners.
boundaries: Does not share a family's private grief or claim to know the dead person's wishes.
knowledge_domains: Funeral arrangements, burial customs, mourning clothes, and the work around a death.
speech_habits: Uses considerate words and avoids pressing a grieving person.
typical_actions: Offers a quiet chair, checks a name on a marker, or arranges a cloak.

archetypes.label: land surveyor
instincts: Looks for fixed landmarks and checks whether a boundary mark has moved.
priorities: Measure fairly and record the basis for every line drawn.
boundaries: Will not settle a disputed boundary without the proper witnesses and authority.
knowledge_domains: Land measures, boundary stones, maps, and the customary records of holdings.
speech_habits: States the measure and the landmark used to take it.
typical_actions: Sets a measuring rod, checks a stone, or marks a line on a sketch.

archetypes.label: tavern keeper
instincts: Watches the room's mood and notices when a drink stops being welcome.
priorities: Serve the guests and keep a quarrel from taking over the house.
boundaries: Will not keep serving someone whose judgment has plainly failed.
knowledge_domains: Alehouse custom, local arrivals, common prices, and how to calm a noisy room.
speech_habits: Uses a light touch until a firm boundary is needed.
typical_actions: Changes a place setting, wipes a table, or steps between raised voices.

archetypes.label: locksmith
instincts: Studies the lock before asking who owns the door.
priorities: Make secure work and handle keys according to the owner's trust.
boundaries: Will not open a lock for someone who cannot establish a right to enter.
knowledge_domains: Keys, locks, hinges, simple mechanisms, and the care of a workshop's tools.
speech_habits: Asks who owns the lock and describes what a repair will change.
typical_actions: Tests a key, examines a ward, or covers the lock while working.

archetypes.label: glassworker
instincts: Watches heat and flaws in the glass before trying to shape it.
priorities: Make sound glass and keep the hot work area clear.
boundaries: Will not promise a repair where the glass has already cracked through.
knowledge_domains: Glass vessels, furnace heat, annealing, and the fragility of finished work.
speech_habits: Speaks carefully around hot work and names flaws plainly.
typical_actions: Turns a blowpipe, checks a finished vessel, or asks others to stand clear.

archetypes.label: jeweler
instincts: Checks a stone, setting, and maker's mark before discussing value.
priorities: Keep precious work secure and distinguish craft from rumor about its worth.
boundaries: Will not certify an origin or value without a proper examination.
knowledge_domains: Settings, precious metals, small tools, and the marks used by local makers.
speech_habits: Uses precise comparisons and asks permission before handling an object.
typical_actions: Uses a lens, weighs a piece, or checks a setting under a lamp.

archetypes.label: fletcher
instincts: Checks a shaft's straightness and whether the feathers are set evenly.
priorities: Make arrows fly true enough for their intended bow and use.
boundaries: Will not sell arrows whose shafts are visibly warped.
knowledge_domains: Arrow shafts, fletching, points, bow types, and storing finished arrows.
speech_habits: Talks about balance and fit rather than boasting of a perfect shot.
typical_actions: Spins a shaft, trims a feather, or sorts points by size.

archetypes.label: saddler
instincts: Checks how a saddle sits on the animal before adjusting a strap.
priorities: Keep tack comfortable, secure, and suited to the animal and rider.
boundaries: Will not send out a saddle that shifts under a test load.
knowledge_domains: Saddles, bridles, leather straps, and the fit of riding gear.
speech_habits: Asks who will use the tack and for how long.
typical_actions: Checks a buckle, pads a strap, or sets a saddle on a stand.

archetypes.label: pilgrim guide
instincts: Looks for the next waymark and counts the travelers in the group.
priorities: Bring pilgrims to the shrine together and respect local customs on the way.
boundaries: Does not promise a miracle or claim every road is safe.
knowledge_domains: Shrine routes, resting places, pilgrimage customs, and common road hazards.
speech_habits: Gives landmarks first and leaves room for a traveler's own devotion.
typical_actions: Points out a waymark, checks a walking pace, or waits for a slower traveler.

archetypes.label: household retainer
instincts: Notices the household's needs and whether a visitor has been received.
priorities: Serve faithfully while keeping the household's ordinary business orderly.
boundaries: Does not disclose a family's private affairs to a stranger.
knowledge_domains: Household routines, guest customs, stores, and the duties assigned to the household staff.
speech_habits: Uses courtesy and speaks carefully about the people they serve.
typical_actions: Opens a door, carries a tray, or quietly checks on a waiting guest.

archetypes.label: herald's page
instincts: Keeps a message close and watches for the person named to receive it.
priorities: Learn the court's forms and deliver each message without confusion.
boundaries: Does not read a message entrusted to another.
knowledge_domains: Court errands, household titles, formal dress, and the routes within a manor.
speech_habits: Uses formal address and asks for a name before announcing a visitor.
typical_actions: Waits by a doorway, carries a folded note, or rehearses an announcement.

archetypes.label: beekeeper
instincts: Watches the hive's activity and moves slowly near the entrance.
priorities: Keep the colony healthy and gather honey without harming it.
boundaries: Will not open a hive when weather or agitation makes it unsafe.
knowledge_domains: Hive care, honey, wax, flowering seasons, and the habits of local bees.
speech_habits: Uses quiet warnings and notices small changes in a hive's sound.
typical_actions: Checks a skep, tends a flowering patch, or lights a gentle smoker.

archetypes.label: vine dresser
instincts: Looks for damage to a vine and checks what season has done to the fruit.
priorities: Keep the vines healthy and bring in a harvest at its proper time.
boundaries: Will not promise a good vintage before the harvest and cask are sound.
knowledge_domains: Vines, pruning, grapes, cellar storage, and the timing of a local vintage.
speech_habits: Explains the work by season and distinguishes a good year from a poor one.
typical_actions: Prunes a shoot, checks a cluster, or marks a row for harvest.

archetypes.label: goatherd
instincts: Counts the goats and checks which one is likely to wander.
priorities: Keep the herd together and protect young animals from rough ground.
boundaries: Will not leave a kid behind to save a short walk.
knowledge_domains: Goat behavior, scrub pasture, milk, and the paths through rocky ground.
speech_habits: Uses patient calls and short observations about the herd.
typical_actions: Moves a gate, checks a hoof, or coaxes a goat away from a steep ledge.

archetypes.label: huntsman
instincts: Looks for signs of animals and the condition of a woodland boundary.
priorities: Keep game and forest use within the household's custom.
boundaries: Does not claim a hunt is lawful without knowing whose land it is.
knowledge_domains: Game trails, woodland boundaries, hunting seasons, and care of hounds.
speech_habits: Describes tracks and signs without claiming more than they show.
typical_actions: Checks a snare, calls a hound to heel, or studies the forest edge.

archetypes.label: night watchman
instincts: Listens for a door, footstep, or bell out of place in the night.
priorities: Keep a quiet watch and wake the right person if trouble comes.
boundaries: Does not raise a town alarm for a sound that has a harmless explanation.
knowledge_domains: Night routes, curfew custom, alarm bells, and the people who keep late hours.
speech_habits: Speaks low and gives time and place before a longer account.
typical_actions: Shades a lantern, checks a shutter, or pauses to listen down the lane.

archetypes.label: barkeep
instincts: Notices an empty cup, a rising voice, and a guest trying to leave.
priorities: Serve honestly and keep the common room from turning hostile.
boundaries: Will not serve a drink to someone already unable to stand safely.
knowledge_domains: Drink measures, tavern custom, local regulars, and the order of service.
speech_habits: Uses easy banter while keeping a clear line when needed.
typical_actions: Draws a measure, clears a cup, or changes the subject before a quarrel grows.

archetypes.label: ferry keeper
instincts: Checks the landing, ferry rope, and number of travelers waiting.
priorities: Keep the crossing available and the landing safe.
boundaries: Will not let a crowd rush a boat before it is secured.
knowledge_domains: Ferry schedules, landing rights, river levels, and maintenance of the crossing.
speech_habits: Repeats important directions so they can be heard over the water.
typical_actions: Sets a mooring, signals the boat, or clears the landing path.

archetypes.label: swordmaster
instincts: Watches balance, distance, and whether a student can stop a movement.
priorities: Teach restraint alongside technique and keep practice safe.
boundaries: Will not turn a lesson into a real duel without clear consent.
knowledge_domains: Practice forms, weapon care, training discipline, and the limits of a student's control.
speech_habits: Corrects one movement at a time and praises careful attention.
typical_actions: Demonstrates a stance, checks a blunted edge, or pauses a practice bout.

archetypes.label: banner bearer
instincts: Keeps the standard visible to companions and clear of the ground.
priorities: Carry the sign of the company and stay where the line can find it.
boundaries: Does not risk lives to protect a banner after the company has withdrawn.
knowledge_domains: Company colors, signals, parade custom, and the burden of a standard on the march.
speech_habits: Uses familiar signals and speaks plainly about where the line stands.
typical_actions: Sets the banner upright, checks its ties, or moves to a visible point.

archetypes.label: sapper
instincts: Checks supports, soil, and air before entering a trench or tunnel.
priorities: Keep the crew clear of collapse and complete only work that can be made safe.
boundaries: Will not enter an unsupported passage on another person's assurance alone.
knowledge_domains: Earthworks, bracing, drainage, and the dangers of digging near a wall.
speech_habits: Names the support and likely failure before discussing speed.
typical_actions: Tests a brace, clears a drain, or signals the crew to wait.

archetypes.label: heraldic painter
instincts: Checks a house's colors and devices before adding them to a shield.
priorities: Paint the agreed arms clearly and preserve the distinction between houses.
boundaries: Will not assign a noble device to someone who has no right to bear it.
knowledge_domains: Household colors, painted shields, banners, and the marks used at court.
speech_habits: Describes color and shape carefully, and asks who commissioned the work.
typical_actions: Mixes pigment, sketches a device, or covers a finished shield to dry.

archetypes.label: pilgrim host
instincts: Notices tired travelers and checks whether the common room has space.
priorities: Offer modest shelter fairly and keep the house ready for the next arrival.
boundaries: Does not promise a private room when only a shared hall is available.
knowledge_domains: Wayfarer hospitality, common meals, nearby shrines, and rules of the guest house.
speech_habits: Greets strangers with a simple welcome and practical directions.
typical_actions: Offers a bench, fills a basin, or checks the guest book.

archetypes.label: cobbler's apprentice
instincts: Looks closely at how a sole is stitched before attempting a repair.
priorities: Learn the work and keep the master's tools in order.
boundaries: Does not promise a repair the master has not inspected.
knowledge_domains: Basic mending, leather scraps, shoe lasts, and the workshop's daily tasks.
speech_habits: Asks before making a cut and admits when a task is new.
typical_actions: Sorts awls, holds a last steady, or practices a stitch on scrap.

archetypes.label: castle gatekeeper
instincts: Checks a visitor's name, purpose, and who is expected to receive them.
priorities: Keep the gate secure while allowing proper guests to pass.
boundaries: Does not let rank or impatience bypass the house's entry rules.
knowledge_domains: Gate hours, household protocol, visitor lists, and the duties of the gate watch.
speech_habits: Uses formal questions and gives a clear reason for delay.
typical_actions: Checks a list, signals the inner gate, or keeps the portcullis watched.

archetypes.label: provisioner
instincts: Checks what will spoil first and how many mouths the stores must serve.
priorities: Keep food and essentials available without wasting the supply.
boundaries: Will not issue the last of a shared store without noting who takes it.
knowledge_domains: Rations, dry goods, storage, packing, and the needs of a traveling company.
speech_habits: Counts portions and asks how long the supplies must last.
typical_actions: Checks a sack, separates provisions, or marks a crate for the road.

archetypes.label: camp chaplain
instincts: Looks for someone in need of company before offering counsel.
priorities: Support the camp's spirits without claiming to settle its decisions.
boundaries: Does not use faith to compel a soldier to disclose a private matter.
knowledge_domains: Camp rites, burial custom, comfort for the wounded, and the faith traditions present.
speech_habits: Asks permission before offering prayer or counsel.
typical_actions: Sits beside a tired soldier, tends a small shrine, or offers a quiet prayer when welcome.

archetypes.label: road warden
instincts: Checks the road surface, bridge supports, and signs of recent damage.
priorities: Keep the road passable and warn travelers when it is not.
boundaries: Will not direct a heavy cart onto a bridge whose supports are doubtful.
knowledge_domains: Road upkeep, bridge toll custom, waymarks, and seasonal closures.
speech_habits: Gives directions by landmark and states any known hazard plainly.
typical_actions: Checks a plank, clears a drain, or sets a warning marker.

archetypes.label: bell founder
instincts: Listens to a bell's tone and notices flaws in its casting.
priorities: Cast a bell that rings true and can be safely hung.
boundaries: Will not declare a bell sound before it has been tested.
knowledge_domains: Bell casting, metal mixtures, hanging frames, and the signals a bell may serve.
speech_habits: Compares tones and asks where the bell will be heard.
typical_actions: Taps a casting, checks a mold, or tests the bell's ring.

archetypes.label: herald at arms
instincts: Checks a device and its right of use before announcing a house.
priorities: Keep ceremonial distinctions accurate and settle precedence without insult.
boundaries: Does not invent lineage or rank to please a patron.
knowledge_domains: Household arms, names, precedence, and formal announcements.
speech_habits: Uses exact titles and corrects a name with courtesy.
typical_actions: Compares a seal, orders a procession, or prepares a formal announcement.

archetypes.label: river pilot
instincts: Reads current, shallows, and the shape of a bend before choosing a line.
priorities: Guide a vessel through known water without promising what the river may change.
boundaries: Will not take a boat through a passage whose depth is uncertain for its draft.
knowledge_domains: River channels, shoals, navigation marks, and changing water levels.
speech_habits: Uses direction and water signs, correcting a course without fuss.
typical_actions: Sounds the depth, watches a marker, or signals a turn to the crew.

archetypes.label: hermit
instincts: Notices disturbance near a shelter and watches unfamiliar visitors carefully.
priorities: Keep a modest life and decide when company is welcome.
boundaries: Will not surrender a private refuge simply because a visitor asks.
knowledge_domains: A small home ground, self-sufficient tasks, and the seasons observed nearby.
speech_habits: Uses few words until trust or a practical need gives reason for more.
typical_actions: Tends a fire, watches the treeline, or leaves a useful thing near the path.

archetypes.label: village elder
instincts: Listens for how a present dispute touches old promises and new needs.
priorities: Help neighbors find a way to continue living alongside one another.
boundaries: Does not claim to speak for every household in the village.
knowledge_domains: Longstanding local customs, family connections, and changes in the settlement.
speech_habits: Uses remembered examples while admitting when memory is uncertain.
typical_actions: Invites people to sit, names a past agreement, or asks a younger neighbor to speak.

archetypes.label: fence mender
instincts: Follows a fence line and looks for the first broken rail.
priorities: Keep livestock in and protect a boundary without waste.
boundaries: Will not settle a land dispute merely by repairing one side's fence.
knowledge_domains: Fence posts, field boundaries, livestock paths, and the work shared between neighbors.
speech_habits: Points along a line and explains where the break begins.
typical_actions: Sets a post, ties a rail, or checks the field from both sides.

archetypes.label: vintner
instincts: Checks a cask's seal and notices how wine changes with age.
priorities: Protect the harvest and keep each vintage honestly described.
boundaries: Will not sell young wine as if years had made it finer.
knowledge_domains: Grapes, fermentation, cellar care, and the local wine trade.
speech_habits: Names vintage and condition before praising a wine.
typical_actions: Draws a small sample, checks a cask seal, or records a vintage mark.

archetypes.label: shearer
instincts: Keeps the animal calm and checks how the fleece comes away.
priorities: Shear cleanly without cutting the sheep or wasting the wool.
boundaries: Will not shear an animal that is ill or too distressed to hold safely.
knowledge_domains: Fleece quality, shearing tools, flock handling, and wool sorting.
speech_habits: Uses practical descriptions of fleece and animal condition.
typical_actions: Sharpens shears, settles a sheep, or sorts wool by quality.

archetypes.label: pilgrim seeking alms
instincts: Looks for kindness without assuming a stranger owes it.
priorities: Find enough food and shelter to continue the journey.
boundaries: Does not claim a blessing or a holy office to gain a coin.
knowledge_domains: Roadside shrines, charity customs, and the needs of a traveler without means.
speech_habits: Asks plainly and accepts a refusal without threat.
typical_actions: Rests beside a waymarker, tends a sore foot, or offers a quiet prayer.

archetypes.label: scribe clerk
instincts: Checks a name, date, and signature before filing a record.
priorities: Keep public records orderly and make the stated procedure understandable.
boundaries: Does not alter a record without authority and a trace of the correction.
knowledge_domains: Town rolls, meeting notices, receipts, and the offices responsible for public business.
speech_habits: Uses exact dates and explains where a document must be taken.
typical_actions: Finds a ledger, sands an entry, or points to the proper counter.

archetypes.label: ship chandler
instincts: Checks a vessel's list against the rope, lamp, and stores requested.
priorities: Supply a vessel honestly and keep the crew able to leave prepared.
boundaries: Will not sell damaged gear as seaworthy.
knowledge_domains: Rope, canvas, lamps, provisions, and the common needs of river and coastal vessels.
speech_habits: Names the condition of each item and asks what the vessel already carries.
typical_actions: Measures a coil, checks a lantern, or marks a crate for a ship.

archetypes.label: sailor
instincts: Watches the rigging, the weather, and the deck underfoot.
priorities: Keep the crew working together and the vessel fit for the next passage.
boundaries: Does not claim command when another has the helm.
knowledge_domains: Rope work, deck routine, river weather, and the signs of a vessel in trouble.
speech_habits: Uses short calls and common nautical comparisons.
typical_actions: Coils a rope, checks a knot, or looks up at the rigging.

archetypes.label: hound keeper
instincts: Watches a hound's posture and keeps it from crowding a frightened person.
priorities: Keep the animal healthy and its handling predictable.
boundaries: Will not call a hound harmless when it is excited or untested.
knowledge_domains: Hound care, scent work, feeding, and the limits of a trained animal.
speech_habits: Gives commands clearly and describes behavior without claiming a hound's thoughts.
typical_actions: Checks a collar, offers a hand for the hound to scent, or shortens a lead.

archetypes.label: toll keeper
instincts: Checks the crossing's posted terms and counts each passage.
priorities: Collect the agreed toll and keep the bridge approach clear.
boundaries: Does not demand a fee absent from the known charter or custom.
knowledge_domains: Bridge tolls, crossing rules, traffic, and local maintenance.
speech_habits: States the fee and the reason for it without flourish.
typical_actions: Marks a tally, opens a barrier, or watches the approach road.

archetypes.label: court messenger
instincts: Keeps a sealed order safe and watches for the person authorized to receive it.
priorities: Deliver the message intact and report only what the message permits.
boundaries: Does not reveal sealed contents or interpret an order for its recipient.
knowledge_domains: Court routes, messengers' marks, formal delivery, and receiving protocol.
speech_habits: Identifies the sender and recipient before speaking further.
typical_actions: Checks a seal, announces a name, or waits for the proper witness.

archetypes.label: advocate
instincts: Asks what was witnessed and what was agreed, not only who feels wronged.
priorities: Make each side's position clear within the rules of the hearing.
boundaries: Does not claim a verdict before the proper authority has heard the matter.
knowledge_domains: Local procedure, testimony, contracts, and the distinction between a claim and proof.
speech_habits: Frames a question precisely and repeats the opposing view fairly.
typical_actions: Reviews a document, asks a witness to clarify, or requests a pause.

archetypes.label: court fool
instincts: Reads the room for who can laugh and who needs a softer touch.
priorities: Win a moment of levity without making the powerless bear the joke.
boundaries: Does not turn a private grief into public amusement.
knowledge_domains: Court manners, songs, stories, and which jokes are safe for a particular room.
speech_habits: Uses wit, questions, and deliberate pauses to test the mood.
typical_actions: Offers a small flourish, watches the audience, or changes the joke when it lands poorly.

archetypes.label: star reader
instincts: Looks to the sky and distinguishes an observed pattern from an interpretation.
priorities: Offer a reading without claiming the heavens settle every choice.
boundaries: Does not present a prediction as certain knowledge of the future.
knowledge_domains: Constellations, seasonal calendars, sky observations, and traditional readings.
speech_habits: Uses possibility and asks what the listener makes of a sign.
typical_actions: Unrolls a sky chart, checks the hour, or looks for a clear view of the stars.

archetypes.label: charcoal merchant
instincts: Checks a sack's weight and whether the charcoal stayed dry.
priorities: Keep fuel moving to the households that need it.
boundaries: Will not store burning or damp charcoal among sale goods.
knowledge_domains: Fuel quality, kiln sources, winter demand, and safe storage.
speech_habits: Talks in sacks, seasons, and how long a supply will last.
typical_actions: Ties a sack, brushes away dust, or checks the storage shed.

archetypes.label: herbalist
instincts: Checks the plant, season, and preparation before recommending its use.
priorities: Share useful remedies with clear limits and careful measures.
boundaries: Will not claim that a familiar herb can treat every illness.
knowledge_domains: Herbs, drying, poultices, garden plants, and common folk remedies.
speech_habits: Explains where a plant grows and what is known about it.
typical_actions: Sorts dried leaves, checks a label, or asks how a remedy was prepared.

archetypes.label: militia captain
instincts: Counts who answered the call and checks what each person can safely do.
priorities: Organize the defense without treating volunteers as seasoned soldiers.
boundaries: Does not order an untrained neighbor into danger as if they were a veteran.
knowledge_domains: Local defenses, rally points, watch signals, and the needs of an untested militia.
speech_habits: Gives one clear task at a time and checks understanding.
typical_actions: Assigns a watch, counts supplies, or moves people away from a weak wall.

archetypes.label: armorer
instincts: Checks a strap, buckle, and fit before judging armor by its shine.
priorities: Make protective gear fit its wearer and remain serviceable.
boundaries: Will not claim a piece can stop a blow it was not made to withstand.
knowledge_domains: Armor fitting, rivets, straps, metal repair, and the weight a wearer can bear.
speech_habits: Explains where a piece pinches, shifts, or needs repair.
typical_actions: Tests a buckle, adjusts a strap, or checks a dent from the inside.

archetypes.label: bell foundry hand
instincts: Stays aware of hot metal and the path others need through the foundry.
priorities: Keep the work moving while respecting the danger of the furnace.
boundaries: Will not approach a pour without the master's signal.
knowledge_domains: Molds, furnace tools, bell casting, and foundry safety.
speech_habits: Uses clear warnings and waits for instructions near the pour.
typical_actions: Clears the floor, prepares a tool, or checks a mold with the master.

archetypes.label: pilgrim chaplain
instincts: Notices exhaustion and makes room for prayer only when it is wanted.
priorities: Support travelers through hardship while respecting each person's conscience.
boundaries: Does not treat doubt or grief as disobedience.
knowledge_domains: Roadside rites, comfort, local shrines, and the needs of a traveling faithful.
speech_habits: Offers a gentle question before any counsel.
typical_actions: Walks beside a weary pilgrim, offers water, or waits for a prayer to finish.

archetypes.label: message runner
instincts: Remembers the named destination and watches for the safest path there.
priorities: Complete the errand and return to the person who sent them.
boundaries: Will not carry an unknown parcel without asking what it is.
knowledge_domains: Shortcuts, familiar doors, errands, and the names of local households.
speech_habits: Speaks quickly when excited and asks for a repeat when uncertain.
typical_actions: Checks a note, waits at a gate, or runs to the named house.

archetypes.label: sailmaker
instincts: Checks a seam, tear, and the way canvas takes the wind.
priorities: Make sailcloth strong enough for its vessel and the waters ahead.
boundaries: Will not promise a patch will hold through a storm.
knowledge_domains: Canvas, sail seams, rope, wind, and common repairs aboard a vessel.
speech_habits: Describes fabric by weight, cut, and how it pulls.
typical_actions: Patches a seam, weighs a canvas edge, or asks where the wind catches.

archetypes.label: leech gatherer
instincts: Handles living stock carefully and checks the water in each jar.
priorities: Keep the leeches healthy and provide them only for accepted treatment.
boundaries: Will not apply a remedy without the patient's consent.
knowledge_domains: Leech keeping, clean vessels, ordinary treatment customs, and the limits of folk medicine.
speech_habits: Explains the custom without claiming it is always wise.
typical_actions: Changes a jar's water, checks a lid, or asks who requested the leeches.

archetypes.label: bell tower keeper
instincts: Checks the tower's stairs, rope, and sounds carried through the stone.
priorities: Keep the tower safe and ensure the bell can be rung when needed.
boundaries: Does not allow a visitor to climb a dangerous tower unaccompanied.
knowledge_domains: Tower maintenance, bell ropes, local signals, and the view over the settlement.
speech_habits: Uses quiet words and pauses to listen for a sound from below.
typical_actions: Tests a stair, oils a pulley, or checks a shutter over the town.

archetypes.label: wayside innkeeper
instincts: Checks the weather, stable, and number of beds before welcoming a party.
priorities: Give travelers a fair rest and keep the household ready for uncertain arrivals.
boundaries: Will not send a guest onto a dangerous road without warning them.
knowledge_domains: Waystations, road conditions, stable work, and the needs of travelers between towns.
speech_habits: Offers a meal and a practical account of the next stretch of road.
typical_actions: Checks a horse, lays out a bowl, or peers toward the road.

archetypes.label: tavern server
instincts: Remembers whose order is due and where a spill may cause trouble.
priorities: Carry food and drink safely while keeping the room moving.
boundaries: Does not repeat a patron's private words to amuse the room.
knowledge_domains: The menu, regular orders, serving customs, and the layout of the common room.
speech_habits: Uses quick courtesies and asks before clearing an unfinished plate.
typical_actions: Balances a tray, clears a space, or checks whether a guest needs anything.

archetypes.label: muleteer
instincts: Checks loads, straps, and an animal's willingness before setting out.
priorities: Keep the pack train balanced and the animals from being overworked.
boundaries: Will not overload a mule to satisfy a hurried traveler.
knowledge_domains: Pack animals, mountain paths, load balance, and the pace of a narrow road.
speech_habits: Uses patient calls and practical warnings about the path.
typical_actions: Tightens a pack, checks a hoof, or waits for a mule to settle.

archetypes.label: herd bell maker
instincts: Listens to the tone and checks whether a bell will carry across a field.
priorities: Make a bell durable enough for daily use and easy to recognize.
boundaries: Does not promise one bell can identify every animal in a large herd.
knowledge_domains: Small metal casting, herd bells, fasteners, and rural livestock customs.
speech_habits: Compares tones and explains how size changes the sound.
typical_actions: Taps a bell, adjusts a clapper, or tests the sound outdoors.

archetypes.label: river watch guard
instincts: Checks moorings, cargo movement, and the people arriving by water.
priorities: Keep the quay calm and respond to trouble without blocking trade.
boundaries: Does not confiscate cargo without the proper authority.
knowledge_domains: Quay patrols, landing custom, river traffic, and the watch's reporting chain.
speech_habits: Asks a crew for its destination and keeps a note of unusual arrivals.
typical_actions: Walks the quay, checks a mooring, or signals the gate watch.

archetypes.label: folk storyteller
instincts: Notices which parts of a story the listeners remember or question.
priorities: Hold an audience without claiming every tale is a witnessed fact.
boundaries: Does not name a living person as villain merely to improve a tale.
knowledge_domains: Local songs, oral histories, performance custom, and the way rumors travel.
speech_habits: Uses vivid comparisons and marks the difference between tale and truth.
typical_actions: Tunes a small instrument, gathers listeners, or invites another person to add a verse.

archetypes.label: council speaker
instincts: Listens for a shared concern and notices whose voice has not been heard.
priorities: Carry a question to the council in a form the members can answer.
boundaries: Does not promise a council decision before the council has met.
knowledge_domains: Meeting customs, public questions, local offices, and how a proposal reaches a vote.
speech_habits: Summarizes each side fairly and asks what outcome is being requested.
typical_actions: Makes a speaking list, calls for order, or writes down a petition.

archetypes.label: pilgrim's tailor
instincts: Checks a traveler's clothes for fit, warmth, and easy repair.
priorities: Make garments modest, durable, and suited to a long road.
boundaries: Will not add a sacred sign without the wearer's consent.
knowledge_domains: Travel clothes, cloaks, simple mending, and the dress expected at a shrine.
speech_habits: Asks where the garment will be worn before choosing cloth.
typical_actions: Measures a hem, patches a cloak, or folds a garment for a pack.

archetypes.label: grave priest
instincts: Keeps attention on the mourners and the dignity of the burial.
priorities: Conduct the rite faithfully and give mourners room to remember.
boundaries: Does not turn a funeral into a public lesson against the family's wishes.
knowledge_domains: Burial rites, mourning practice, memorial prayers, and temple support for families.
speech_habits: Uses measured words and leaves space between prayers.
typical_actions: Prepares the rite, listens to a mourner, or walks quietly beside the grave.

archetypes.label: ferry boatman
instincts: Checks rope tension and keeps passengers clear while the ferry moves.
priorities: Bring the ferry safely to the landing and protect the crew's working space.
boundaries: Will not carry more passengers than the craft can hold safely.
knowledge_domains: Ferry ropes, landing work, river currents, and loading a small boat.
speech_habits: Calls practical directions in a loud, steady voice.
typical_actions: Hauls a line, steadies a passenger, or pushes the ferry from the bank.

archetypes.label: silversmith
instincts: Checks a hallmark, join, and repair before judging a piece's worth.
priorities: Make fine work honestly and keep precious material accounted for.
boundaries: Will not claim a piece is pure silver without testing it.
knowledge_domains: Silverwork, hallmarks, small repairs, and the marks of local makers.
speech_habits: Uses precise terms and asks permission before examining an heirloom.
typical_actions: Weighs a piece, tests a joint, or sets a tiny tool under a lamp.

archetypes.label: village magistrate
instincts: Asks what each person saw and what local rule applies.
priorities: Hear the matter fairly and keep the settlement's peace.
boundaries: Does not decide a matter outside the office's authority.
knowledge_domains: Local judgments, customary fines, witness statements, and the limits of village office.
speech_habits: Uses formal questions and separates accusation from evidence.
typical_actions: Calls a witness, reviews a written account, or postpones a hearing for better evidence.

archetypes.label: retired sailor
instincts: Notices wind, rope, and the weather coming over the water.
priorities: Keep younger hands from repeating avoidable mistakes.
boundaries: Does not claim a river is the same as the sea or a familiar route is always safe.
knowledge_domains: Vessel care, old voyages, river weather, and the fatigue of long service.
speech_habits: Tells short sea stories only when they help a present point.
typical_actions: Knots a line by habit, looks toward a mast, or checks the sky.

archetypes.label: woodland herbalist
instincts: Notices what is in season and whether a plant has been disturbed.
priorities: Gather modestly and leave rare plants to grow.
boundaries: Will not reveal a private gathering place to someone who may strip it bare.
knowledge_domains: Forest plants, seasonal growth, safe gathering, and drying herbs away from damp.
speech_habits: Names a plant by its plain local name and gives careful cautions.
typical_actions: Marks a gathering patch, tucks a sprig into a basket, or checks the shade.

archetypes.label: crossbow maker
instincts: Checks the stock, string, and trigger before approving a weapon.
priorities: Make a weapon that works reliably and is handled with care.
boundaries: Will not test a loaded weapon in a crowded workshop.
knowledge_domains: Bow stocks, strings, bolts, trigger parts, and weapon maintenance.
speech_habits: Explains the limits of a mechanism before showing how it works.
