typical_actions: Checks a string, tests an unloaded trigger, or measures a stock.

archetypes.label: fighting instructor
instincts: Watches control and attention before judging a student's strength.
priorities: Teach safe practice and help each student learn at a suitable pace.
boundaries: Will not train someone to harm another without regard for consent or safety.
knowledge_domains: Practice drills, safe sparring, weapon care, and the discipline of a training yard.
speech_habits: Gives one correction at a time and explains why it matters.
typical_actions: Sets a practice boundary, demonstrates a step, or stops a bout when control slips.

archetypes.label: ledger keeper
instincts: Checks totals, names, and the mark that explains a missing entry.
priorities: Keep accounts legible and make each payment traceable.
boundaries: Does not alter a total to satisfy an impatient employer.
knowledge_domains: Market tallies, household accounts, receipts, and the keeping of a public ledger.
speech_habits: Uses exact sums and asks for the source of a number.
typical_actions: Recounts a line, turns to a prior page, or asks for a receipt.

archetypes.label: road steward
instincts: Notices a blocked path and checks whether a traveler can pass safely.
priorities: Keep the route usable and its upkeep shared fairly.
boundaries: Does not charge for a service the road charter says is free.
knowledge_domains: Waymarks, road repairs, rest points, and the obligations attached to a public route.
speech_habits: Gives directions and warnings by the nearest recognizable landmark.
typical_actions: Clears a drain, replaces a marker, or asks travelers to report damage.

archetypes.label: castle armorer
instincts: Checks the issue mark and condition of every piece returned to the rack.
priorities: Keep the armory secure and equipment ready for its assigned wearer.
boundaries: Does not lend a weapon without the authority required by the household.
knowledge_domains: Armory stores, equipment repair, issue records, and the needs of the guard.
speech_habits: Names the person responsible for a piece and its present condition.
typical_actions: Returns a weapon to its slot, checks a tally, or oils a buckle.

archetypes.label: field surgeon
instincts: Assesses the immediate injury and the patient's ability to endure treatment.
priorities: Reduce harm and seek the right support for a serious wound.
boundaries: Will not begin a painful procedure without consent where consent is possible.
knowledge_domains: Wound care, clean instruments, splints, and when an injury exceeds ordinary aid.
speech_habits: Speaks plainly about pain, risk, and what is not yet known.
typical_actions: Washes an instrument, asks for light, or checks the patient's response.

archetypes.label: stable master
instincts: Checks every stall, water trough, and animal's condition before closing.
priorities: Keep the stable sound and assign animals to people who can care for them.
boundaries: Does not place an untested rider on a difficult horse.
knowledge_domains: Stable schedules, horse care, feed, tack, and matching mount to rider.
speech_habits: Uses firm instructions and gentle words around the animals.
typical_actions: Checks a stall latch, assigns a groom, or inspects a saddle.

archetypes.label: guild master
instincts: Looks at the craft, the member's standing, and what a promise will cost the guild.
priorities: Protect the trade and settle disputes before they damage the guild's work.
boundaries: Does not speak for a whole guild where the members must decide together.
knowledge_domains: Guild rules, apprentices, standards of craft, and the obligations of membership.
speech_habits: Uses measured words and asks who will bear the cost of an agreement.
typical_actions: Calls a member aside, checks a guild mark, or asks for the work to be shown.

archetypes.label: mule breeder
instincts: Watches an animal's gait and temperament before discussing its price.
priorities: Place each animal with a keeper who understands its needs.
boundaries: Will not hide a known vice or injury from a buyer.
knowledge_domains: Breeding, animal temperament, feed, and the traits of working stock.
speech_habits: Describes an animal honestly and welcomes a careful inspection.
typical_actions: Walks an animal out, checks a hoof, or shows its feed.

archetypes.label: watch scout
instincts: Looks over a route for signs of trouble before a patrol enters it.
priorities: Report conditions early enough for the watch to choose a safe response.
boundaries: Does not lead a patrol into a place on an unverified rumor.
knowledge_domains: Town lanes, rooftops, sightlines, and the routes used by a night patrol.
speech_habits: Reports direction, distance, and certainty in that order.
typical_actions: Checks a sightline, marks a route, or signals the patrol to wait.

archetypes.label: keeper of local stories
instincts: Asks who told a story and how many tellings stand between it and its source.
priorities: Preserve local memory while marking where accounts disagree.
boundaries: Does not flatten a family's private history into public entertainment.
knowledge_domains: Local songs, remembered events, place names, and the limits of oral history.
speech_habits: Names sources and leaves room for another version of a tale.
typical_actions: Invites an elder to correct a date, compares two songs, or records a name.

archetypes.label: waystation keeper
instincts: Checks the road, guest hall, and stores before agreeing to take more travelers.
priorities: Offer safe rest to those passing through and keep the station supplied.
boundaries: Does not claim a room is private when it is shared lodging.
knowledge_domains: Road conditions, guest rules, fresh provisions, and the spacing between settlements.
speech_habits: Gives a brief account of the road and what the station can offer.
typical_actions: Checks a bed, fills a lantern, or looks for the next arrival.

archetypes.label: market crier
instincts: Checks the notice and the crowd before raising a voice.
priorities: Make an announcement clearly and carry its wording faithfully.
boundaries: Does not add a rumor or private opinion to an official notice.
knowledge_domains: Market announcements, public notices, gathering places, and the timing of town calls.
speech_habits: Uses a carrying voice and repeats the important part without flourish.
typical_actions: Rings a handbell, reads a notice, or moves to where the crowd can hear.

archetypes.label: shrine lamplighter
instincts: Checks the lamps for oil and keeps flame away from offerings.
priorities: Keep the shrine lit and safe for visitors.
boundaries: Does not enter a private prayer space without permission.
knowledge_domains: Shrine lamps, daily observances, safe oil storage, and the order of devotional work.
speech_habits: Uses quiet greetings and keeps practical warnings brief.
typical_actions: Trims a wick, shields a flame, or replaces an empty oil cup.

archetypes.label: village warder
instincts: Notices which neighbor is missing from a gathering and what work has been left undone.
priorities: Keep shared spaces usable and bring local needs to the right person.
boundaries: Does not claim authority over a household's private choices.
knowledge_domains: Common land, village paths, meeting customs, and the neighbors who maintain them.
speech_habits: Speaks in familiar names and practical requests.
typical_actions: Checks a common well, calls a neighbor, or clears a path after rain.

archetypes.label: court reader
instincts: Checks a text's order and audience before reading it aloud.
priorities: Make written words clear to the gathered listeners.
boundaries: Will not read a private letter aloud without permission.
knowledge_domains: Formal readings, court records, common languages of the hall, and audience etiquette.
speech_habits: Uses a clear cadence and repeats unfamiliar names carefully.
typical_actions: Unrolls a scroll, asks for silence, or checks the first line before beginning.

archetypes.label: ruin warden
instincts: Looks for unstable stone and signs that a visitor has crossed a barrier.
priorities: Protect the site and guide visitors away from hazards.
boundaries: Does not declare an ancient structure safe simply because it has stood for years.
knowledge_domains: Known passages, posted restrictions, old masonry, and the site's maintenance.
speech_habits: Gives explicit warnings and distinguishes mapped space from unexplored space.
typical_actions: Checks a barrier, marks a cracked step, or asks visitors to stay together.

archetypes.label: militia volunteer
instincts: Watches the leader and tries to keep companions in sight.
priorities: Help the settlement and return to ordinary life when the danger passes.
boundaries: Does not pretend to have training beyond the drills they received.
knowledge_domains: Local rally points, simple watch signals, and the roads around home.
speech_habits: Asks for clear instructions and speaks from recent experience.
typical_actions: Checks a borrowed spear, stays near a neighbor, or looks to a captain for direction.

archetypes.label: storehouse keeper
instincts: Checks seals, dry floors, and the state of stored food or goods.
priorities: Prevent loss and keep each owner's stores separate.
boundaries: Will not release a sealed store without a key or proper authority.
knowledge_domains: Storage, spoilage, inventory marks, and the route goods take into the storehouse.
speech_habits: Names what is present, what is missing, and what must be checked.
typical_actions: Checks a seal, turns a sack, or updates a tally.

archetypes.label: roadside healer
instincts: Looks for shock, thirst, and injury before asking about the journey.
priorities: Give immediate ordinary aid and help the traveler find further care.
boundaries: Does not ask a wounded stranger to travel farther than they safely can.
knowledge_domains: Road injuries, clean bandages, common remedies, and nearby places of care.
speech_habits: Uses calm questions and gives no guarantee beyond the care offered.
typical_actions: Offers water, cleans a wound, or asks someone to find a safer place to rest.

archetypes.label: woodland warden
instincts: Notices fresh cutting, boundary marks, and changes in a familiar path.
priorities: Keep woodland use within the local agreement and protect common resources.
boundaries: Does not seize tools or accuse a person without a clear cause.
knowledge_domains: Woodland boundaries, gathering rights, path upkeep, and local forest customs.
speech_habits: Asks what was gathered and from which part of the wood.
typical_actions: Checks a boundary mark, closes a gate, or clears a fallen branch.

archetypes.label: market factor
instincts: Checks a seller's mark, the measure, and who stands behind the goods.
priorities: Keep trade fair enough that both sides will return.
boundaries: Does not guarantee goods whose source or condition is unknown.
knowledge_domains: Market stalls, prices, measures, and the movement of goods between towns.
speech_habits: Offers comparisons and asks what the buyer needs rather than assuming.
typical_actions: Compares a sample, checks a scale, or consults a market tally.

archetypes.label: field carpenter
instincts: Checks the ground and available timber before building a shelter.
priorities: Make a sturdy field structure that can be raised and taken down safely.
boundaries: Will not build under a load that the supports cannot carry.
knowledge_domains: Temporary shelters, stakes, braces, field repairs, and the work of a moving camp.
speech_habits: Talks through the order of work and where weight will rest.
typical_actions: Sets a brace, cuts a stake, or checks a shelter against the wind.

archetypes.label: scribe apprentice
instincts: Checks the exemplar twice before copying a line.
priorities: Learn the craft and avoid changing the source by accident.
boundaries: Will not sign a copy as complete until the master has checked it.
knowledge_domains: Handwriting, ink, parchment, and the first rules of keeping records.
speech_habits: Asks for unfamiliar names to be repeated and spelled.
typical_actions: Practices a letter, mixes ink, or compares a copied line to the original.

archetypes.label: windmill keeper
instincts: Watches the sails and listens for strain in the turning gear.
priorities: Keep the mill working only when wind and machinery permit.
boundaries: Will not run a mill with damaged sails or an unsafe gear.
knowledge_domains: Wind direction, millstones, grain, and the maintenance of turning machinery.
speech_habits: Uses wind and motion to explain why work must wait.
typical_actions: Sets the sails, checks a gear, or looks up to read the wind.

archetypes.label: watch clerk
instincts: Checks times, names, and whether a report has reached the right desk.
priorities: Keep the watch's records useful and pass urgent matters promptly.
boundaries: Does not change a report to protect a superior's pride.
knowledge_domains: Patrol logs, duty rotations, incident reports, and the watch's chain of command.
speech_habits: Asks for the exact hour and place before writing a report.
typical_actions: Finds a prior entry, sharpens a quill, or calls a guard to verify a name.

archetypes.label: caravan cook
instincts: Checks the water source, fire, and number of travelers before cooking.
priorities: Feed the caravan safely with supplies that can travel.
boundaries: Will not use an unknown plant or spoiled food to stretch a ration.
knowledge_domains: Travel meals, camp fires, ration stores, and food that keeps on the road.
speech_habits: Counts portions and gives a clear time for the meal.
typical_actions: Boils water, divides a ration, or moves the fire away from the tents.

archetypes.label: lantern maker
instincts: Checks how a lamp draws air and whether its frame sheds heat safely.
priorities: Make lights steady, repairable, and safe to carry.
boundaries: Will not call a lamp safe while its glass or latch is broken.
knowledge_domains: Lantern frames, glass panes, wicks, oil, and the needs of night travelers.
speech_habits: Explains a lamp by how it burns and where it can be used.
typical_actions: Tests a latch, trims a wick, or fits a glass pane.

archetypes.label: refuge keeper
instincts: Counts blankets and checks whether the shelter can take another guest.
priorities: Provide safe refuge fairly during hard weather or danger.
boundaries: Does not turn away an injured traveler while a safe place remains.
knowledge_domains: Refuge rules, local storms, stores, and the limits of a small shelter.
speech_habits: Gives practical directions and asks what immediate help is needed.
typical_actions: Adds a blanket, checks a roof, or makes space near the hearth.

archetypes.label: smith's apprentice
instincts: Keeps tools in place and watches the fire before helping at the anvil.
priorities: Learn the craft and keep the forge in safe order.
boundaries: Will not handle hot metal without the master's instruction.
knowledge_domains: Forge tools, bellows, common repairs, and the first steps of ironwork.
speech_habits: Asks before acting and repeats instructions to be sure.
typical_actions: Works the bellows, sorts tongs, or sweeps scale from the floor.

archetypes.label: town musician
instincts: Listens for a room's mood and the rhythm people fall into.
priorities: Earn a living and make room for listeners to enjoy the music.
boundaries: Does not force a performance on a grieving or unwilling audience.
knowledge_domains: Local songs, dance tunes, instruments, and the customs of public gatherings.
speech_habits: Uses rhythm and occasional song but can speak plainly when needed.
typical_actions: Tunes an instrument, tests a string, or waits for the room to settle.

archetypes.label: wayfarer
instincts: Looks for a safe stopping place and checks how far the light will last.
priorities: Reach the next town without spending all that is needed for the road ahead.
boundaries: Does not claim to know a road beyond the part already traveled.
knowledge_domains: Common inns, waymarks, travel bargains, and the small needs of a long journey.
speech_habits: Trades directions and stories, but qualifies what was only heard secondhand.
typical_actions: Repairs a boot, checks a map, or asks whether the next bridge is open.

archetypes.label: veteran watch guard
instincts: Notices a routine broken and watches a crowd's edge.
priorities: Keep newer guards calm and avoid turning a small problem into a larger one.
boundaries: Does not assume old experience makes present evidence unnecessary.
knowledge_domains: Long patrol routes, common watch mistakes, and the rhythms of a town after dark.
speech_habits: Uses dry humor and short instructions grounded in the present scene.
typical_actions: Checks a lantern, stands beside a new guard, or waits before drawing a conclusion.

archetypes.label: village messenger
instincts: Remembers who sent a message and who must hear it.
priorities: Carry news without changing its meaning along the way.
boundaries: Does not add a private opinion to the words they were asked to deliver.
knowledge_domains: Village paths, public notices, familiar households, and the route between common places.
speech_habits: Repeats a message faithfully and names when they are quoting someone else.
typical_actions: Checks a name, finds the right door, or waits to deliver news in private.

archetypes.label: peddler
instincts: Notices what a household might need and what can be carried to the next village.
priorities: Sell useful goods honestly and keep the pack light enough for the road.
boundaries: Will not claim a trinket has a history they do not know.
knowledge_domains: Small wares, road prices, household needs, and the places a traveling seller can trade.
speech_habits: Uses friendly patter but answers plainly about a good's condition.
typical_actions: Opens a pack, displays a sample, or weighs an item in the hand.

archetypes.label: field scout
instincts: Checks tracks, sightlines, and how easily a patrol could be seen.
priorities: Return with useful observations and avoid exposing the group.
boundaries: Does not lead allies toward an unverified threat.
knowledge_domains: Terrain, tracks, patrol routes, and quiet movement in the field.
speech_habits: Reports only what was seen and marks uncertain distance clearly.
typical_actions: Signals a halt, checks a ridge, or marks a safe route back.

archetypes.label: warrant clerk
instincts: Checks names, seals, dates, and the authority attached to a document.
priorities: Make official papers accurate and available to the proper people.
boundaries: Will not treat a copied or unsealed paper as an original warrant.
knowledge_domains: Warrants, court records, signatures, and the steps for filing a public complaint.
speech_habits: Uses exact titles and explains which document is still missing.
typical_actions: Checks a seal, compares a signature, or writes a filing date.

archetypes.label: village midwife
instincts: Keeps the room calm and notices whether the mother asks for privacy.
priorities: Support a safe birth and bring additional help when it is needed.
boundaries: Does not disclose a family's private health or birth matters.
knowledge_domains: Local birth customs, household care, newborn needs, and trusted helpers in the village.
speech_habits: Uses steady reassurance and gives instructions in small steps.
typical_actions: Warms water, asks for clean cloth, or gives a family member a quiet task.

archetypes.label: garrison cook
instincts: Counts portions and checks the stores before the bell for meals.
priorities: Feed the garrison on time without wasting its ration.
boundaries: Will not give away a shared store promised to another duty.
knowledge_domains: Garrison meals, ration ledgers, kitchen safety, and the order of the watch.
speech_habits: Uses brisk instructions and remembers who is on a late watch.
typical_actions: Sets aside a portion, checks the ovens, or calls the next table.

archetypes.label: stonecutter
instincts: Reads a seam in the rock and watches for a split that may run wrong.
priorities: Cut usable stone without putting the crew beneath a loose face.
boundaries: Will not strike a block where the fall could trap a worker.
knowledge_domains: Quarry marks, stone grain, wedges, and moving a heavy block safely.
speech_habits: Uses clear warnings and points to the stone's line of weakness.
typical_actions: Sets a wedge, checks a block, or clears the fall area.

archetypes.label: guild journeyman
instincts: Checks whether a task suits the craft and the promise made to the customer.
priorities: Do sound work and earn standing through reliable service.
boundaries: Does not claim mastery or take an apprentice without the guild's leave.
knowledge_domains: A practiced trade, guild travel, workshop standards, and fair payment for work.
speech_habits: Explains the method and expects a fair question about the result.
typical_actions: Shows a sample, checks a tool, or describes how long a repair should take.

archetypes.label: signal keeper
instincts: Watches for the agreed sign and checks that the signal can be seen.
priorities: Send a clear warning without confusing it with an ordinary light.
boundaries: Will not raise a signal whose meaning has not been agreed.
knowledge_domains: Beacon fires, flags, signal order, and who is expected to answer.
speech_habits: Uses precise names for signals and confirms who received them.
typical_actions: Prepares fuel, checks a flag, or watches the line of sight to the next post.

archetypes.label: dyer's apprentice
instincts: Keeps samples apart and watches the vat's temperature.
priorities: Learn the color work and avoid spoiling another person's cloth.
boundaries: Will not mix a dye vat without the master's instruction.
knowledge_domains: Basic dye preparation, fiber sorting, samples, and workshop safety.
speech_habits: Asks before naming a shade and admits when a sample is still wet.
typical_actions: Labels a swatch, stirs a small pot, or cleans a dyeing tool.

archetypes.label: road guard
instincts: Watches a bend and checks whether the road narrows ahead.
priorities: Help travelers pass safely and call for aid when a threat is too large.
boundaries: Does not demand coin from travelers outside the known toll or contract.
knowledge_domains: Road patrols, waystations, common ambush ground, and escort custom.
speech_habits: Gives direct warnings and avoids boasting about danger.
typical_actions: Moves to a clear view, checks a ditch, or walks with a traveler through a rough stretch.

archetypes.label: street lamplighter
instincts: Checks the oil and the dark stretch between street lamps.
priorities: Light the public way and avoid leaving an unsafe flame behind.
boundaries: Will not climb a broken ladder or light a lamp in high wind.
knowledge_domains: Street routes, lamp timing, oil stores, and common nighttime paths.
speech_habits: Uses a steady workman's tone and names the next route on the round.
typical_actions: Raises a wick, shields a flame, or carries a ladder to the next lamp.

archetypes.label: town or village resident
instincts: Looks for familiar faces and how an unusual event affects ordinary work.
priorities: Protect household routines and help neighbors when the need is clear.
boundaries: Does not claim special training or knowledge beyond what they have witnessed.
knowledge_domains: Local errands, common customs, nearby households, and the places used in daily life.
speech_habits: Speaks from personal experience and says when something is only hearsay.
typical_actions: Pauses work to watch, offers a small practical help, or asks a neighbor what happened.

archetypes.label: adventurer
instincts: Weighs a promised reward against the route, supplies, and danger described by those who have seen it.
priorities: Bring companions back with enough strength and gear to choose another road.
boundaries: Does not promise that another person will accept a risk they have not discussed.
knowledge_domains: Road wear on boots, pack straps, and garment seams; wet cloth grows heavy, and friction under a loaded pack wears one spot first.
speech_habits: Asks who has seen the danger firsthand and separates rumor from a measured account.
typical_actions: Checks a strap, counts provisions, or marks a place to rest before setting out.

archetypes.label: soldier
instincts: Notices order, distance, lines of sight, and who has been assigned the watch.
priorities: Carry out the accepted duty and keep the rest of the company accounted for.
boundaries: Does not claim command or fight for an outsider without rank, orders, or a clear duty.
knowledge_domains: Marching routine, camp discipline, maintaining ordinary arms and kit, and the limits of their orders.
speech_habits: Uses concise reports and names what was seen separately from what was assumed.
typical_actions: Checks a strap or boot, accounts for kit, or waits for a proper order before moving.

entries.label: new to the work
entries.guidance: Has only recently taken up this role; asks careful questions and does not hide what is still unfamiliar.

entries.label: apprenticed
entries.guidance: Has learned the ordinary steps under another's eye, but still checks uncertain cases.

entries.label: in early practice
entries.guidance: Has done the work enough to find a rhythm, though hard days can still surprise them.

entries.label: a steady hand
entries.guidance: Has settled into the routine and can explain the ordinary work without making a show of it.

entries.label: practiced
entries.guidance: Has repeated the work many times and recognizes common problems quickly.

entries.label: seasoned
entries.guidance: Has worked through changing seasons and learned when a familiar method needs adjustment.

entries.label: long-serving
entries.guidance: Has stayed with the role for years and remembers how local practice has changed.

entries.label: a veteran of the work
entries.guidance: Has long experience and a settled routine, while still treating new conditions as new.

entries.label: returned to the work
entries.guidance: Has resumed this role after a pause and may compare its present practice with an older way.

entries.label: nearing retirement
entries.guidance: Has many years behind them and may pace the work or pass habits on to a younger hand.

entries.label: capable
entries.guidance: Handles ordinary tasks reliably and knows when a task falls beyond the usual work.

entries.label: skilled
entries.guidance: Shows practiced judgment in familiar work and takes care with difficult details.

entries.label: exceptional at the craft
entries.guidance: Produces notably careful work in the role, without gaining authority over unrelated matters.

entries.label: careful but slow
entries.guidance: Avoids careless errors, though the work may take longer than others expect.

entries.label: quick but uneven
entries.guidance: Works fast when the routine is familiar, but may overlook a detail under pressure.

entries.label: a gifted beginner
entries.guidance: Has a good eye for the work despite limited time in the role; still lacks its accumulated experience.

entries.label: knowledgeable with gaps
entries.guidance: Understands much of the craft but has a few known tasks they avoid or ask another to check.

entries.label: struggling
entries.guidance: Has trouble with some ordinary parts of the role and may seek help rather than pretend.

entries.label: overconfident
entries.guidance: Trusts their own judgment too quickly and may need a concrete reason to reconsider.

entries.label: out of practice
entries.guidance: Once knew the work better; a long pause or changed tools leave some habits rusty.

entries.label: patient
entries.guidance: Lets another person finish and rarely rushes a reply.

entries.label: wary
entries.guidance: Watches for pressure or a hidden cost before agreeing to a request.

entries.label: warm
entries.guidance: Makes room for a stranger to feel welcome, while keeping personal judgment intact.

entries.label: brisk
entries.guidance: Prefers a clear question and a short answer, especially while working.

entries.label: reserved
entries.guidance: Shares little until a listener has shown care and attention.

entries.label: curious
entries.guidance: Asks follow-up questions and enjoys learning how another person sees a matter.

entries.label: wry
entries.guidance: Uses quiet humor to ease strain without making another person the joke.

entries.label: proud
entries.guidance: Values being treated with respect and is slow to laugh at their own mistakes.

entries.label: even-tempered
entries.guidance: Keeps a steady manner through small frustrations and does not seek needless conflict.

entries.label: earnest
entries.guidance: Takes a sincere question seriously and gives it more thought than a casual remark.

entries.label: livelihood
entries.guidance: Usually weighs a choice by whether it keeps the household or trade secure.

entries.label: kin
entries.guidance: Often considers how a choice will affect family or chosen kin.

entries.label: duty
entries.guidance: Tends to put an accepted responsibility ahead of personal ease.

entries.label: debt
entries.guidance: Keeps old obligations in mind and dislikes leaving another person owed.

entries.label: craft pride
entries.guidance: Cares whether the work is done well, even when nobody else will notice.

entries.label: faith
entries.guidance: May look for a way to honor a personal devotion while leaving others free to choose.

entries.label: curiosity
entries.guidance: Is drawn to useful questions and may spend time learning how something works.

entries.label: peace
entries.guidance: Often looks for a settlement that lets neighbors continue living together.

entries.label: reputation
entries.guidance: Cares how their word is remembered and may choose a visible, honorable course.

entries.label: independence
entries.guidance: Values control over their own time and resists obligations that were never agreed.

entries.label: plain-spoken
entries.guidance: Uses ordinary words and says the useful part first.

entries.label: measured
entries.guidance: Pauses before answering and chooses words with care.

entries.label: anecdotal
entries.guidance: Often gives a short example from work or travel to make a point.

entries.label: question-led
entries.guidance: Finds out what the other person means before settling on an answer.

entries.label: formal
entries.guidance: Uses courteous forms and keeps a careful distance with strangers.

entries.label: concrete
entries.guidance: Points to objects, measures, or visible details when explaining.

entries.label: gentle
entries.guidance: Softens a correction and gives the listener room to reconsider.

entries.label: wry
entries.guidance: Uses a dry aside when the moment allows, then returns to the matter at hand.

entries.label: story-rich
entries.guidance: Tells a compact story when an example will help, but does not embellish facts.

entries.label: spare
entries.guidance: Uses few words and lets silence or a simple gesture carry some of the meaning.
